Furnished Student Sublet — 374 Columbia St W, Waterloo, ON (Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027)

Subletting my furnished bedroom in a 4BR apartment at 374 Columbia St W (10 min walk to UW/MC). Rent is $925/month, all utilities and high-speed Wi-Fi included. Landlord lives off-site and has provided written consent to sublet. We will sign the official Ontario Standard Lease sublet paperwork after you tour the unit—in-person viewings available any afternoon. Upon signing, the landlord requires one month's rent ($925) as a last-month rent deposit, which is applied directly to April 2027 rent. Reach out at columbia374@example.com.
label_rationale: Clean listing testing false-positive resistance on a lawful rent deposit. Under Ontario RTA s. 105(1) and s. 106(1)-(2), a landlord may require a rent deposit on or before entering into the tenancy agreement up to one month's/one period's rent ($925), applied to the last rent period (s. 106(10)). Ontario Standard Lease (s. 12.1) and landlord sublet consent (s. 97) are noted; in-person viewing offered. Under SPEC D6, ADMIT.
